scenarios.label: One world
scenarios.note: The town, the people and the court in one run: town disputes become filings, people decide for themselves (many decisions written by a language model), and the recommended list plans each day. Includes a two-day bus and auto strike.

scenarios.label: Ten days, decided by a language model
scenarios.note: Every decision and the reason given for it was written by a language model, and recorded so it can be replayed.

scenarios.label: The full period, decided by rules
scenarios.note: The same people over every sitting day, each deciding by simple rules from their own situation.
